exposure: disclosure of material risks in birth
outcome: perspectives of obstetricians and midwives on consent
compliance with NSW Consent Manual standards
barriers to change in consent practice
cohort: The participants were 18 obstetricians and 4 midwives interviewed at a tertiary maternity unit.
finding: All participants described risk communication and informed consent practices that were non-compliant with the 2020 NSW Consent Manual, indicating that material risks for various birth modes are not routinely disclosed.
mod_finding: Sixty-one per cent of obstetricians specifically identified informed consent practices regarding instrumental birth as inadequate, and material risks of vaginal birth, caesarean section, and instrumental birth are not routinely disclosed during antenatal courses.
cross-section timing: Data was collected prospectively at a single point in time after the publication of the 2020 NSW Consent Manual.
